rows.grounds: forms compound with preceding sa denoting the syllable sa

items.question: Which syllable is claimed to be identical with the goddess?
premises: The term devī denotes the goddess.
The expression sa kāraḥ denotes the syllable sa.
The verse predicates sa kāraḥ of devī.
items.inference: The goddess is identified with the syllable sa.
items.plain_english: The goddess is the syllable sa.
